CRH/Oldcastle.headline: $8.5B acquisition of Arcosa announced
CRH/Oldcastle.summary: CRH announced an $8.5B acquisition of Arcosa, a major construction-materials and infrastructure products company, expanding CRH's aggregates and infrastructure footprint significantly.

Vulcan Materials.headline: Vulcan Materials acquires Butler Quarry in Pendleton County, Kentucky
Vulcan Materials.summary: Vulcan Materials has acquired Butler Quarry, a hard rock limestone operation in Pendleton County, Kentucky, from Hilltop Stone. The site has served the Northern Kentucky and Greater Cincinnati construction materials markets for over 70 years.
Vulcan Materials.sales_angle: Reach out to Vulcan's regional leadership to pitch contract mining, pit development, and overburden stripping support during their operational integration of the new site.

Vulcan Materials.headline: Vulcan Materials Acquires Butler Quarry in Northern Kentucky
Vulcan Materials.summary: Vulcan Materials has acquired the Butler limestone quarry in Pendleton County, Kentucky, from Hilltop Stone. The 70-year-old operation supplies hard rock aggregate to the Greater Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky markets.
Vulcan Materials.sales_angle: Engage Vulcan's regional operations team to provide contract stripping, mine planning, or supplemental load-and-haul capacity as they integrate the newly acquired quarry.

Vulcan Materials.headline: Vulcan Materials Acquires Butler Quarry in Kentucky from Hilltop Stone
Vulcan Materials.summary: Vulcan Materials has acquired the Butler Quarry located in Pendleton County, Kentucky, from Hilltop Stone. The transaction was advised by The Greystone Group.
Vulcan Materials.sales_angle: Reach out to Vulcan's Mideast division leadership to offer contract drilling, loading, hauling, and stripping services during the quarry integration.

Vulcan Materials.headline: CEO transition and Brannan Sand & Gravel acquisition
Vulcan Materials.summary: Vulcan completed a CEO transition and acquired Brannan Sand & Gravel, expanding its Colorado/Texas aggregates footprint as part of a broader western-market growth push.

Amrize.headline: $900M 2026 capex program; PB Materials and Rapid Redi-Mix acquisitions
Amrize.summary: Amrize is executing a $900M investment program for 2026, including capacity expansion at Ste. Genevieve. Also acquired PB Materials (26 sites, West Texas) and Rapid Redi-Mix (Dallas-Fort Worth).

Rogers Group.headline: Rogers Group pursues rezoning and annexation for 542-acre mine in North Carolina
Rogers Group.summary: The Town of New London scheduled an October 6, 2026 public hearing on Rogers Group requests for voluntary annexation and M-2 heavy manufacturing conditional rezoning. The approvals would enable development of a new aggregate mine across approximately 542 acres in Stanly County.
Rogers Group.sales_angle: Contact Rogers Group greenfield project managers to introduce Turner Mining Group for site development, initial overburden removal, and pioneering services.
Rogers Group.publisher: Town of New London, North Carolina

Rogers Group.headline: Rockydale Quarries acquisition — 13th deal in two years
Rogers Group.summary: Rogers Group acquired Rockydale Quarries, its 13th acquisition in roughly two years, expanding into Virginia and North Carolina.

Titan America.headline: Keystone Cement acquisition closed
Titan America.summary: Titan America closed its acquisition of Keystone Cement (Pennsylvania), expanding its cement production capacity in the Northeast.

Heidelberg Materials.headline: Autonomous haulage expansion to 6 sites
Heidelberg Materials.summary: Heidelberg Materials is expanding its autonomous haulage program (piloted at Lake Bridgeport, TX) to roughly 6 sites and 30 vehicles across its US aggregates operations in 2026.

Quikrete.headline: Missouri DNR issues open-pit limestone permit for Quikrete's Jasper Quarry #15
Quikrete.summary: The Missouri Department of Natural Resources Land Reclamation Program approved an active open-pit limestone mining permit for the 37-acre Jasper Quarry #15 in Barton County, Missouri. The site is operated by Cornejo and Sons dba Midwest Minerals under Quikrete Materials.
Quikrete.sales_angle: Connect with Midwest Minerals and Quikrete operational leads to offer contract overburden removal, drilling, and blasting support under the newly active quarry permit.

Quikrete.headline: $2.8B Martin Marietta asset exchange
Quikrete.summary: Quikrete completed a $2.8B asset exchange with Martin Marietta, receiving the Midlothian, TX cement plant, related terminals, and North Texas ready-mixed concrete assets — the largest deal in Quikrete's history.

CalPortland.headline: Northern California Teamsters strike resolved
CalPortland.summary: Over 350 CalPortland ready-mix drivers across 15 Northern California plants (Sonoma, Marin, Napa, Solano counties) went on strike Aug 6-21, 2026, disrupting public and private construction projects until a new contract was ratified.
